English.Char_Desc_2000:
PinSharp ICO is an ultra-sharp Windows icon builder dedicated to extreme downscaling clarity from 256px down to 16px.
Standard downscaling tools frequently introduce frustrating artifacts when generating icons: white outlines fade into muddy gray, tight dark slits vanish, and edges blur out into vague silhouettes at 16x16 or 24x24. PinSharp ICO tackles this extreme compression process (a 1/256 area reduction) through a dedicated perceptual downscaling engine, preserving crisp contrast for fine borders, typography, and narrow gaps.
Key Features: 1. Engineered for Extreme 256px to 16px Downscaling Retains high contrast and vibrant color intensity for delicate outlines and slits even when compressed down to micro-pixel dimensions.
2. Automated Instant Saving on Drag-and-Drop Simply drop your 256x256 PNG file into the window. Processing starts instantly, saving the finished .ico file into the same directory without prompting save dialogs.
3. Complete Coverage of All 11 Standard Windows Sizes Fully supports 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 72, 96, 128, and 256 px. Quickly switch configurations using presets (All, Standard, Compact) or individual toggle buttons.
4. Zero-Halo Boundary Clamping Employs mathematical local bounding box clamping to fundamentally eliminate unnatural white halos and ringing artifacts around high-contrast contours.
5. Ascending Size Previews Instantly displays up to 5 result preview thumbnails in ascending order (smallest first) upon completion, allowing immediate legibility checks.
6. Ultra-Fast Portable Execution Compiled with Native AOT technology, it launches instantly without footprint or dependency overhead. No .NET runtime or installation is required.
Developed by chilili kobo. Available as freeware for personal and commercial use.
